title: CT deep learning radiomics with body composition predicts MSI in colorectal cancer
summary: In 873 colorectal cancer patients from three centers, deep learning and radiomics features from portal venous CT were combined with body-composition clinical factors in a random forest to predict microsatellite instability. The combined model had AUCs of 0.882 in training, 0.768 internally and 0.803 and 0.751 in two external cohorts, above the clinical model (0.607-0.730) and the deep learning radiomics model (0.712-0.841). The study is retrospective; the authors say prospective validation is needed before clinical adoption.
ai_technology: Deep learning and radiomics CT features combined with body composition in a random forest, with SHAP and Grad-CAM interpretation
organization: Southern University of Science and Technology; First People's Hospital of Foshan

evidence.unknown: Prospective performance; modest external AUCs (0.751-0.803); full text not reviewed.
